say:2:1041534501:1.text: It's that time of year again.

say:3:1041534502:1.text: Cold, dark... even the snowflakes fall, only to fade into endless nothing.
say:3:1041534502:1.source_cn: 寒冷，黑暗，连转瞬即逝的冰雪都足以化为永恒。

say:4:1041534503:1.text: This is the season of us Graveborn, isn't it?
say:4:1041534503:1.source_cn: 这是属于我等亡灵的日子……不是吗？

say:5:1041534504:1.text: Exactly, Your Majesty. The stillness of death, so peaceful, so eternal—only now can we truly appreciate it.
say:5:1041534504:1.source_cn: 正是如此，陛下，这漫长与宁静的安详之死，唯有此时此刻才...

say:6:1041534505:1.text: Speaking of which, your little... creations won't be going into some kind of hibernation, will they?
say:6:1041534505:1.source_cn: 说到这个，你的那些小宝贝们，不会冬眠吧？

say:7:1041534506:1.text: These things, forged from flesh and magic, are no more mortal than we are.
say:7:1041534506:1.source_cn: 这是通过魔法与血肉凝聚的造物，当然不会如凡俗之物那般——

say:8:1041534507:1.text: ...Wait, were you trying to make a joke, Your Majesty?
say:8:1041534507:1.source_cn: ……不对，您刚刚是在开玩笑吗，陛下？

say:9:1041534508:1.text: Heh... it's been ages since I've met someone with less sense of humor than me.
say:9:1041534508:1.source_cn: 呵……我也是很久没有遇到比我更没有幽默感的家伙了。

say:10:1041534509:1.text: I suppose that wasn't a compliment, was it?
say:10:1041534509:1.source_cn: 我猜，这也不是一句夸奖吧，陛下？
